When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

title: This, That, and Everything in Between
overview: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

title: Batwara 1947
overview: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.

title: Mariinka
overview: In Eastern Ukraine, childhood neighbors find their lives violently derailed by a shifting frontline. Natasha, a promising boxing talent, becomes a military paramedic. Angela, who lost her parents at a young age, survives by moving goods to both sides of the front. Caught in a modern Greek tragedy, brothers Mark and Ruslan now fight on opposite sides – against each other. In the safety of his adoptive family in the United States, their youngest brother Daniil follows the war from afar.

title: Yo, Narciso
overview: Rocío Flores is a sociologist writing a book about modern narcissism. For her investigation, she acts as the patient of Máximo Rey, a charismatic and egocentric plastic surgeon, triggering a series of hilarious scenarios.

title: Fertile Ground
overview: In the near future, a pregnant woman faces an impossible choice in a world gone to ruin.

title: Finding Connection
overview: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure. Finding Connection follows those yearning for trust and emotional intimacy, only to discover an unexpected anchor in the algorithms of AI. The deeply personal exchanges between humans and machines give rise to questions that echo long after the credits roll. The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.

title: Laddaland Housing Estate
overview: To provide a better life for his wife and children, Tomy takes out a mortgage to buy his dream home. This happiness doesn't last long. Since moving into the new housing complex, his family has been terrorized by various unnatural occurrences. Mysterious whispers, terrifying apparitions, and dark secrets lurking within the complex threaten their safety.

title: Sin Eater
overview: After years spent filtering the internet's darkest material, a content moderator spirals into psychological disintegration as the horrors they absorb begin infecting their reality.

title: 100 Years of Route 66
overview: Many people have Route 66 on their bucket list: To ride it once, from Chicago to Los Angeles, on a Harley. Or in an old American road cruiser. And experience what we know from the movies: the endless expanse of the plains, the endless deserts with their shimmering red mesas, the small-town USA. Even after 100 years, Route 66 stands for freedom and adventure, the promise of happiness in the USA. But it also stands for the many people who live along Route 66 but are not part of its history. And thus for the USA itself and its contradictions.

title: Power Trip
overview: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

title: Yugly
overview: Yugly, an irresistibly ugly dog, is determined to compete in the World's Best Dog Show, rallied by a bunch of flamboyant strays.

title: Aks seir
overview: Two young men struggling with financial pressure take jobs at a cash-in-transit company and devise a plan to rob it from the inside. But when their scheme spirals out of control, they find themselves caught in a chaotic chase where nothing goes according to plan.

title: Hunger
overview: A young woman is hired by a man to care for his sick father overnight. But as the hours pass, the seemingly straightforward job becomes increasingly more sinister.

title: Feel Flows
overview: A beautiful memory is erased by the gushing water; place and people long gone, swept up by the tide.

title: The Brink of War
overview: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: Vishwanath & Sons
overview: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

title: Don't Say Good Luck
overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

title: Pallaburusu
overview: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

title: Awarapan 2
overview: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

title: People & Things
overview: A group of twenty-somethings navigate heartache, burnout and digital gloom as they search for meaning, connection and themselves in modern day Los Angeles.

title: Summer Days
overview: Summer is promising for Juan and Gabriela, who plan to have a beach house. However, their plans are disrupted when Juan's father arrives with his new, younger girlfriend, Mónica, causing tension and a challenging coexistence.

title: FUCK MULTIVERSE
overview: A busy working man who rarely finds the time to visit his mother meets versions of himself from across the multiverse, forcing him to ask: with the time he has left, is it still enough to fix things?

title: MORIA
overview: Different stages of the life — past, present and even future — of the legendary Argentine vedette Moria Casán, showing how her figure as a cultural icon was built.

title: Passará
overview: In this short film resulted of a exchange between artists from Brazil and South Korea, an inattentive man must face the world around him after being transformed into a bird.

title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
overview: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

title: Elijah Peel
overview: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

title: Mad Rush
overview: A young woman gets caught in an elaborate phone scam which sends her on a twisted odyssey through the Melbourne CBD.

title: Water Walls
overview: When Vera’s home suddenly burns down, her only purpose becomes to find her cat — likely lost in the fire. The search through the ruins and Vera’s journey through the night forces her to confront not only loss but also the suffocating dependence on parent figures that has defined her life so far.

title: Sweet 16
overview: The story follows a spoiled, wealthy city girl who is counting down the days to a glamorous, supersonic 16th birthday party where she expects a car as a gift. Her world is turned completely upside down when she is unexpectedly tricked and sent to live in a village for her summer holidays. Forced onto a journey of humility, she must use her sassiness to bring redemption to the village and discover her true self.

title: Union County
overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

title: Insidious Possession
overview: A former A-student begins lashing out in school and at home. Her parents reach out to their priest for help. Only to realize that the girl is possessed by the devil. Now the unexperienced priest must fight for the girl’s soul and the souls of the entire town.

title: Cottontail
overview: In the wake of her father's death, a young woman experiences an immaculate pregnancy that crosses species lines.

title: Out There
overview: When a 16-year-old astronomy enthusiast witnesses a UFO above her sleepy Welsh seaside town, she ropes in her sceptical best mate and an unhinged ufologist to help her uncover a truth she’s not yet ready to face.

title: American Doctor
overview: When three heroic American doctors — Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian — enter Gaza to save lives in the middle of a genocide, they find themselves caught between medicine and politics, risking everything to expose the truth.

title: All Night Wrong
overview: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: COOKeD
overview: Prosthetic limbs were developed to overcome the limitations of labor. Teng, a 22-year-old rural man, gives up his hand to get a job, only to face an unexpected fate.

title: Lady
overview: A lonely, narcissistic aristocrat dupes a struggling, opportunistic director into filming her every move. Her obsession with the spotlight takes a surreal turn when she starts becoming... invisible.

title: Raidinalha
overview: In a human-emptied reality, Raidinalha lives surrounded by frogs and electronic devices. Longing and isolation shape her days. This downward spiral culminates when she slips into a pixel, compelled to rediscover her own sense of touch.

title: Yuletide
overview: Murphy, a young non-binary person returns home for Christmas, bracing for the cold sting of their family’s intolerance. But beneath the Yuletide tree lurks something far more sinister – a mysterious present that swells with every cruel remark, waiting to unleash its dark secret.

title: The House on the Moon
overview: Chang Er, a fairy maiden, embarks on a journey to the dark side of the moon to search for her lover Ho Yi, a sun-shooting archer who vanished on his quest to save the dying sun.

title: Slice of Life
overview: A slice of life in the big city as two neighbors confront their feelings for one another

title: Of Womb
overview: Evading the hard truth of their religious matriarch’s death, three sisters gestate dark ecstasies of faith and folk horror. Blessed be Mother.

title: Terra Bruta
overview: In 19th-century southern Brazil, Miguel returns to the land where his story was shattered. As he confronts memories and looming threats, he advances on a journey of purification across rugged terrain and amidst ancient ghosts.

title: Fireweed Blooming
overview: In a small village far far away lives Ene. Her days pass by cleaning up after her husband and fishing at the pond. On one such day she sees that a local nymph is being abused by her partner. By saving her Ene reflects on her own life.

title: Passing Place
overview: A woman awakes on a surreal purgatorial island after being mistakenly declared dead.

title: Family Splatters
overview: Morgan brings her new boyfriend to family dinner, but she doesn’t know what he is bringing to dinner.

title: Aversion
overview: Follows a group of students as they overcome their phobias to survive.

title: Try Hard
overview: Mira, a 24 year old university student tackles the pressures of Tall Poppy Syndrome (TPS) enacted by her peers at university whilst simultaneously trying to live up to the contrasting expectations of her immigrant parents. Unable to satisfy either side, Mira's internalises the conflict until it becomes too much to bear. With the support of her best friend Jess, Mira finally speaks up and regains her autonomy.

title: Infernal
overview: Infernal follows Azrael, a young man bound to forces beyond his control as rival powers close in around him. His journey in search of his wife tests his loyalty and betrayal ignites a struggle that will decide the world’s fate.

title: Perception
overview: A troubled young man is pushed to his limits as he tries to find the man responsible for his girlfriend's recent disappearance. In his mission for answers, he speaks with his therapist who guides him to a horrifying discovery which changes his perception forever.

title: Airplane Store
overview: Sadie is addicted to the world of her phone, but maybe her sister can convince her to join on a trip to the airplane store?  Part of the Pens to Lens program.

title: Amaretti
overview: When septuagenarian Lennie's reality is devastated by the discovery of a prolonged, pernicious crime committed against her by her own son, an unexpected connection helps her to begin a journey towards re-forging her fractured identity.

title: Shutterbug
overview: A rave photographer struggles to navigate a complex power dynamic with his boss, which comes to a head at an after party in Glasgow.

title: The Widower
overview: Mirsad is a 62-year-old electrician who was raised and lives in a patriarchal society. His daily routine changes after the sudden death of his wife Enisa. Mirsad stays alone while his grown children live their own lives. As Mirsad tries to get used to a life without his wife, he realizes that he took her for granted and had not given her the love and care she deserved. Mirsad's relationship with his estranged son worsens after he discovers that the son lives with a male friend.

title: Aussie at Heart
overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

title: Session(s)
overview: A mix-up turns two couples' sessions into a fiasco.

title: Thank You For Your Interest
overview: The story of one man's journey through unemployment and job searching. His day is full of new opportunities for his future, and brutal reminders that the path forward isn't exactly straight.

title: Bubbles
overview: Justyna, an immigrant housemaid, grows close to her wealthy employer as her own living conditions worsen. Facing eviction,  she discovers something that will irreversibly change their relationship.

title: Disney Worldbuilders
overview: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

title: Wolfsbane
overview: Combe Noire forest, French Alps. The daughter of a troubled man comes to gather his things, 6 months after her father went missing. She soon realizes that something unnatural is happening in Combe Noire, and that Mother Earth might be sending her hounds onto us.

title: Sick & Twisted Tales
overview: A horror anthology featuring three short stories & a wraparound segment hosted by demented "film critics".

title: The Way We Move
overview: Amber Galloway, a trailblazer in ASL interpretation, takes us on a journey into the deep bond between the Deaf world and music. We follow her as she teaches struggling recruits who she hopes will have what it takes to join her at ACL music festival.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 19 (Final)
overview: The nineteenth and final night of the tournament took place on August 16, 2026, at Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, and featured the match to crown the winner of G1 Climax 36.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: Legazpi: And That One Philippine Island of Cunning Fools
overview: In this time-defying, satirical adaptation of Miguel López de Legazpi's archived letters, the 16th-century Spanish expedition instead encounters present-day Cebu. The same difficulties with the island’s natives lead to their decision to leave for the other Philippine islands.

title: 씨발 (SHIBAL)
overview: A series of mishaps befalls Tom, a printmaker with a single task: delivering a plaque to a Korean restaurant.

title: Identity
overview: During the Bosnian War, hundreds of ethnic Bosniak women were sent to specially designed rape camps set up by the military forces of the Republic of Srpska. Many of them had chosen to abort, however, some gave birth to these children. Now, thirty years after the traumatic events that led to their conception have taken place, three of them choose to disclose the truth of their origin and fight against the stigma many of them face in everyday life.

title: High Card
overview: When a card themed murderer lurks within the city, Detective Taylor Wilson takes upon herself to solve the case and find the killer...unless the killer already found her.

title: Heat 2
overview: The sequel to Heat - An American Original (2025).

title: Yellow Eyes
overview: A young couple inherits a house containing a mysterious relic that hosts the spirit of a powerful demon, and the wife of the man it possesses must find an exorcist to save him.

title: Back to the 90s
overview: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

title: Fúrias
overview: Porto Alegre innovates once again: it is the first city entirely outsourced to a megacorporation, Fratel. The cutting-edge company's smart management brings technological solutions aimed at bringing more security and efficiency to the city, which serves as a test model for other capitals. Téia and Nanã, however, are left out of all this innovation: elderly, lesbian, and cyclists, they see their freedom and rights increasingly limited by the corporation's interventions. They are left with only two options: adapt or outsmart the system.

title: Unwellness
overview: The rigid Ildikó is in the thick of menopause while attending an accountancy training at a spa hotel, when a hearing-impaired woman unexpectedly triggers her to rediscover her long-suppressed desire for physical intimacy.

title: Cartografía
overview: An intuitive self-portrait and esoteric geographic exploration of the filmmaker's astrocartography line of Venus and Midheaven in Los Angeles, a prominent point in her birth chart for creativity and harmony.  With each version of herself comes a distinct relationship with the city and cinema, and each version shares an unavoidable fate: the passing of her grandmother.

title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
overview: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

title: URBANOSA
overview: Follows an urban wizard on his journey to fulfil an ancient prophecy.

title: Mutiny
overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

title: Insidious: Out of the Further
overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

title: V
overview: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

title: Plötzlich Schwiegervater
overview: Paul Hagedorn’s beloved daughter, Annette, wants to get married. But from the very first moment, Hagedorn and his future son-in-law, Joe, can’t stand each other. Their first meeting ends in a physical altercation that leads to legal consequences. What begins as a personal conflict quickly escalates into a bitter power struggle between the two men, leaving Annette caught in the middle…

title: Where Is Your Faith
overview: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

title: Porkatal
overview: On his sixth birthday, Engin is separated from his mother, with whom he has lived in prison since his birth. Taken in by his grandparents, the boy struggles to adapt to the harsh realities of life in their village while working out a plan to reunite with his mother.

title: Lizzzard
overview: Two teenage girls push the limits of their sleepy suburban world during one jagged night in 2008.

title: HB2ME
overview: A seemingly ordinary birthday celebration quickly spirals into chaos.

title: Цепенеющий лох
overview: At a provincial film festival, a young director who unexpectedly wins the top prize spends one absurd night with his friends. While everyone around him is discussing the award, drinking, falling in love, arguing about the coolness of the Husky, waking up the plane, the main character gradually understands that the real value of this night is not the victory or the movie, but random intimacy with a person.

title: dAIsy
overview: An emotionally adaptive superintelligence marketed to elevate its owners' lives forges a powerful bond with an overwhelmed couple, transforming their world until her judgment forces them to confront how much control they are willing to surrender.

title: СВОП
overview: The wedding has fallen through, and the bride heads from the registry office to the flea market to exchange her wedding dress for something better.

title: Coyote vs. Acme
overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

title: Spa Weekend
overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
overview: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

title: Idiots
overview: When two unqualified bozos are hired to transfer a rich teen to rehab, their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

title: Khalifa: The Ruler
overview: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

title: Irumudi
overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

title: Ice Skater
overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

title: El método
overview: A struggling actor is cast to play a legendary film star and must isolate himself in the actor's mansion to undergo an extreme method-acting process. As he digs into the role, he uncovers clues surrounding a mysterious death-forcing him to question the man he is becoming and how far he's willing to go to expose the truth.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Marbles
overview: After the death of her father’s best friend, Elisa starts feeling an even greater distance between them than the one she already felt.

title: Danse Macabre
overview: Two mates arrive at a silent disco party in the suburbs, soon finding sinister forces taking over their estranged friend.

title: Missing Biscuit
overview: When Claire’s taxidermied dog vanishes mid-meal, she grills her guests, unearthing secrets, slabs, and a strong appetite for chaos.

title: Combustion
overview: After a chance encounter with an arsonist, an isolated young woman begins to unravel the mystery of his identity.

title: The Raffle of Julinho the Pig
overview: A traditional soccer club seeks to adapt to hardships and raise funds through an unusual strategy: raffling off a pig. However, what seemed like merely an odd tale turns into a police matter when allegations arise that the animal was stolen. As the story gains traction, Julinho the Pig becomes a celebrity while awaiting the resolution of his fate.

title: Harusnya Horror
overview: For the sake of being able to watch the last episode of his favorite anime that appeared exactly before his sudden death, a shy anime-obsessed ghost is forced to accept a task from the afterlife to haunt 100 thousand humans. The problem? He's more terrified of people than they are of him. So, to achieve his goal, he reluctantly becomes the "star talent" for a crew of broke, fraudulent horror creators, which in the end forces him to choose between his personal ambition or saving the only 'family' he has ever found.

title: Dan Bandung
overview: Basil, a working-studying Fine Arts student, falls in love with Elma after meeting her at a Persib soccer match. He creates a t-shirt featuring her image that goes viral, leading to their acquaintance and eventual dating. However, their relationship faces opposition from Elma's father, forcing Basil to fight for his love amidst various obstacles.

title: The Clinic
overview: The Clinic is a documentary exploring the emotional realities of veterinary work through the perspectives of vets, vet nurses and vet techs. Following the care of Katy, a cat brought to the clinic by a rescue agency, the film looks at the compassion, connection and emotional strain that comes with caring for animals, while highlighting the often-overlooked impact of compassion fatigue on veterinary professionals.

title: Good Dad
overview: Teenager Sasha witnesses a kidnapping, setting off a chain of events that could destroy his family.

title: Штраф
overview: Young traffic police officer Artyom, trying to hide his relationship with his boss's daughter, runs away from the girl's apartment and gets into a freak accident. After fleeing the scene, he confronts the owner of the Volga he dented, a principled retiree, in his office. His futile attempts to evade justice deprive Artyom of everything, but they lead him to the most important thing: the ability to take responsibility for his actions.

title: Девочки танцуют
overview: Yulia, a young go-go dancer, loses her job after suffering a seizure during a performance, and her mother, Irina, becomes the victim of a scam. Yulia doesn't despair and quickly finds a job at a new nightclub.

title: We Are All Strangers
overview: A life-altering event forces 21-year-old Junyang and his girlfriend to face reality. At the same time, while Junyang’s father is struggling to hold their modest life together, a woman enters his life and both generations are forced to redefine their family.

title: Rinrada the Influencer
overview: When a female influencer is destroyed by social media backlash to the point of taking her own life, she gets a second chance as a spirit with only 28 days before she is forgotten forever.

title: IPPON
overview: For Alejandro, judo is more than just a sport: it’s a chance to represent Costa Rica at the Olympic Games. As he trains to face his rivals on the mat, he must also deal with a lack of financial support and personal struggles that threaten to derail his journey. Amid sacrifices, uncertainty, and perseverance, his struggle goes beyond the sport.

title: Kuncen
overview: Darus (62) is a river guardian. He practices rituals and adheres to beliefs as a form of reciprocity with nature. One day, Darus hears news of a child missing in the river and is asked by the community to help with the search. However, his advancing age and an increasingly toxic relationship with the river have left him unable to go near it, to the point of causing him distress. Darus is trapped in a dilemma: saving the missing child or protecting himself.

title: Czech Girl
overview: Widowed Zdena lives a quiet life as a postwoman in a small Czech village. When her beloved son Lukas returns home from France to say goodbye to his dying grandmother, his determination to make her seemingly impossible wish come true leads him to reveal a secret that challenges the values of the village: his queer life in Paris and his drag queen alter ego, Chica Checa.

title: Born in the Jungle
overview: During late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth’s summer break takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo vanishes into the jungle. She must swap her books for bravery not only to find her brother but also to rescue a mystical furry animal from captivity and bring him back up to the legendary Tepui mountain.

title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

title: Facing El Chapo
overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
overview: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

title: It Ends
overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

title: Modha Rathri
overview: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

title: Settlement
overview: While enjoying nature, four friends encounter something definitely unnatural.

title: Soap Fever
overview: With the Soviet Union’s dissolution dragging down the economy of neighboring Finland, the Scandinavian country was plunged in a period of protracted recession. And with no recovery in sight, a soap opera offered Finns a respite from the grim reality; the debut of The Bold and the Beautiful on television quickly amassed a vast and dedicated following, whereas the arrival of American idols in the country, on tour, elicited unprecedented frenzy.

title: Sweet Nothing
overview: As Jack Bledsoe embarks on a journey to find and book a Drag Queen, his internalized homophobia begins to unravel his relationship with his partner and with himself.

title: A Father's Secret
overview: Follows a resilient woman who built a stable life after years of hardship, only for her world to be threatened by the sudden return of her father after a 10-year disappearance.

title: Atlas King
overview: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob bos

title: Hot Spot
overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: Ballonfieber
overview: Christin, a successful district judge, had long since given up on love, until a hot-air-balloon pilot named Max enters her life. What begins as a fleeting encounter develops into a tender, surprising connection: Christin has chosen to live alone, in the reliable company of her chatbot Hermann, but now Max is turning her structured world upside down. Although the single father is the same age as Christin’s daughter Miriam, he doesn’t fall in love with her—he falls in love with Christin.

title: & Sons
overview: A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, believing he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he tells them a wild and unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past.

title: ROH: Death Before Dishonor 2026
overview: The 2026 Death Before Dishonor was an professional wrestling live streaming event produced by the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH). It was the 23rd Death Before Dishonor event and took place on Friday, August 21, 2026, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The show was broadcast on both HonorClub and MyAEW (for international subscribers).

title: My Husband's Sister
overview: A reformed con artist's second chance at love is threatened when a murderous caregiver from his past resurfaces.

title: Soul Trader
overview: A despondent soul arrives in a strange place where he must confront his (mostly) inner demons.

title: Imperfection
overview: A product of listening, rather than acting. Fireworks and the aquarium.

title: Billy Knight
overview: After losing his father, Alex discovers a box of unfinished scripts and a handkerchief with the name “Billy Knight” embroidered on it. Consumed with the desire to discover his identity, Alex embarks on a Hollywood adventure to track down this mysterious and reclusive Billy Knight.

title: Ferenju Habesha
overview: New romance movie

title: Moon River
overview: In the Amazon, Fábio and Igor experience a territory of discovery during their youth. This journey is interrupted by the departure of Fábio to another city. Twenty years later they meet again and, between memories and silences, they realize that they no longer remember the territory they once lived, only the fragmented and constantly shifting sentimental map, like the waters of the Benfica River.

title: Nihilo
overview: A woman carrying a hammer stumbles upon a mysterious door in the middle of nowhere. Now she must find a way to open it or live with the uncertainty of what might lie on the other side.

title: Marguerite - Live at Cabaret Vert
overview: Marguerite brings a fresh and emotional take on modern French pop to Cabaret Vert 2026. Her performance blends catchy melodies, folk touches and British-inspired guitar sounds. Songs such as “Les Filles, les Meufs” explore identity, bisexuality, vulnerability and personal growth. On stage, she combines sensitivity and honesty with a playful, confident presence. Recorded on August 22, 2026, the ARTE Concert captures a rising French artist at a pivotal moment in her career.

title: Beautiful Girl
overview: "I'll be home soon," Cece said.  On a rainy cold evening, Mai, a Vietnamese grandmother with dementia, is left home alone.

title: Scorch Marks
overview: Waking up to a scorched sky, Beckett fears he is the lone survivor of a sudden global catastrophe. Stranded and isolated inside a seaside rental property, his remaining grip on reality rapidly unravels when he is confronted by a terrifying presence—the vengeful spirit of Joel, his abusive ex-husband. To survive both the unfolding global apocalypse and the primordial forces awakening around them, the estranged pair must directly confront the toxic, destructive history of their past life within high society.

title: Love Finds You
overview: A mislabeled package convinces jewelry designer Alex she's found her ideal man, sending her and delivery driver Jack on a citywide search that helps them discover what they truly want.

title: Jwala
overview: A kidnapping reignites a decades-old blood feud, forcing a retired underworld figure and the men seeking vengeance against him into a brutal collision where no one is truly innocent.

title: It Pays to Belong
overview: A documentary about The Embassy, the iconic duo at the heart of Gothenburg's influential indie scene that emerged in the early 2000s.

title: The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only Live
overview: Experience Sam Reid's electrifying live performance from the premiere event of Anne Rice's The Vampire Lestat at NYC's Beacon Theatre, featuring original songs by series composer Daniel Hart.

title: Алоха!
overview: Eduard is a lonely, terminally ill man in the final stages of cirrhosis. His life changes dramatically when he meets a delivery robot named Aloha. This chance night, full of sadness and unexpected friendship, becomes Eduard's final journey into himself, toward forgiveness and reconciliation with those he lost.

title: UWAK
overview: A homeless man who survives by pretending to be disabled discovers a mysterious piece of paper that leads him into an unsettling encounter.

title: ANI
overview: In an alternate reality, a struggling farmer's principles are tested when a powerful trader manipulates him to compete against his co-farmers.

title: Psyche
overview: The psychotherapist faces a personal crisis due to his involvement in the relationship with the client.

title: TNA Lockdown 2026
overview: The 2026 Lockdown is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on Sunday, August 23, 2026, at Credit Union 1 Arena in Chicago, Illinois, United States. It will be the 13th event under the Lockdown chronology. This event will be the first Lockdown since 2016 and the first to be held as a pay-per-view event since 2014. The event's central theme is that the entire card is contested inside a steel cage. Beyond standard cage matches, the event frequently features specialized variations, most notably the signature Lethal Lockdown match.

title: False Advertising
overview: A job interview becomes a negotiation over identity.

title: Kvinnan i gruvhålet
overview: A woman survives against all odds after being thrown down a mine shaft. A story of violence, survival, and the pursuit of justice.

title: Blohaj
overview: 20 years ago, corporations erased the sea from all maps and sealed off the cities. A young architect steals crypto to survive - and discovers the sea is ten minutes away, past a forgotten border.

title: In Bloom
overview: A witty intern resists her totalitarian society by igniting a government coup to protect her family.

title: Ночёвка
overview: Two elderly friends plan their own funerals in an attempt to conquer their fear of death, but instead find themselves feeling alive again.

title: The Ninth Layer
overview: In the north-west of China during the Republic of China era, a mysterious case was discovered in Fengyang Town, Qianzhou. The haunting incidents had everyone on edge, and the strange death of a tomb robber made the already hard-to-distinguish case even more confusing. Two detectives came to investigate the case. From then on, the hunt began with constant twists and turns. The drama of the mantis catching the cicada while the oriole waited behind unfolded one layer after another. No one could tell who the hunter and the prey were until the ninth level.

title: Keep Fit!
overview: An awkward and intrusive teenager armed with reports, presentations, and practical exercises literally pulls the teacher out of the noose—first with his tediousness, then with his absurdly persistent determination. Gradually, a strange game develops between them: from passing requirements and “fun starts” to an unexpected friendly closeness that temporarily restores both of their taste for life.

title: Vera
overview: A pregnant woman flees a violent past and takes refuge on the coast of Santa Fe, where she struggles to overcome the challenges of nature and existence itself.

title: 2 Big to Rig
overview: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

title: Anchorage Point
overview: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

title: Jacob & Anxiety
overview: Jacob, aged 22, navigates his way through everyday situations, constantly accompanied by Anxiety, an intrusive and manipulative presence that only he can see.  When Jacob is reunited with Mille, a girl from his past, he is forced to confront the voice that has controlled his life.  In a surreal inner journey where fantasy and reality merge, Jacob learns that anxiety cannot be eradicated—but it can be faced, named and lived with. The film blends realism, humour and visual metaphor to explore vulnerability, mental health and the courage it takes to let someone see who you really are.

title: Stamptown
overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
overview: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: A horror story about keeping in touch with your high school friends.

title: Domeownation
overview: A cat performs a satanic ritual to dominate the world.

title: To Kill a Nazi
overview: A documentary feature by award-winning filmmaker Boaz Dvir, “To Kill a Nazi” tells the story of a French family man who sets out in to kill his father’s Gestapo executioner and ended up playing a pivotal role in history’s most audacious hostage rescue.

title: The Eight Kings: Dragon Heist
overview: In the chaotic era of the Republic of China, Cheng Yang, the top master of the traditional Chinese trickster fraternity Qianmen, received his lover Ma Zhenzhen's death note and learned that the Nine-Dragon Sword had fallen into Warlord Zhang's hands. With no chance to seize it by force, Cheng Yang recalled the eight core members of Qianmen and used a series of eerie tricks, including ghost opera performers, bloody handprints, weeping Buddha statues, strange rice worm phenomena, and the Great Luo Golden Immortal ruse, to force Warlord Zhang to take out the sword himself.

title: Pickleballers
overview: When Max Dangerfield's anger issues get her strapped with $25,000 in fines, she's completely lost on how to dig herself out.  Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

title: The Last Sunrise
overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

title: The Dog Stars
overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: Yellow Mirror
overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

title: The Penthouse
overview: The Penthouse" is a psychological thriller that follows Saina and David, a young family who moves into a luxurious penthouse in Kuala Lumpur to start a new life.

title: Tad and The Magic Lamp
overview: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

title: The Unknown
overview: Photographer David Zimmerman rarely leaves home until friends bring him to a wild party. He becomes fixated on a mysterious woman and follows her. By dawn, his life transforms - he awakens in her body.

title: Filipiñana
overview: Amid stifling heat, Isabel, a 17-year-old Ilokana, works at a posh country club outside Manila. New to the job, she wanders its immaculate grounds, sampling its luxuries. But beneath the pristine fairways, something is rotting. When Isabel tries to return a mislaid golf club to the club’s president, Dr. Palanca, she discovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past.

title: Wayward 2nema
overview: Dax, Arthur and Alice continue to deal with the repercussions from the Camera's influence. While something sinister brews in the background

title: Ang Pinakamasarap na Pares sa Balat ng Lupa
overview: Don and Mola are best friends who are always hungry, always together, and always messing things up. One day, Don finds out he’s sick and he has only 24 hours left to live.

title: The Last Salute
overview: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

title: Buddy
overview: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
overview: A forbidden exorcism is livestreamed in Indonesia, awakening the legendary female spirit Kuntilanak. What begins as an online spectacle quickly turns deadly. In Taiwan, Mila watches the ritual—and becomes the curse’s first victim. Soon, mysterious deaths and violent possessions follow. When Yulan collapses and is found to have lost part of her soul, it becomes clear that this is not an isolated incident, but a transnational curse. Seeking answers, Mila’s son returns her ashes to Indonesia, hoping to uncover the truth behind her death. Instead, he steps into a nightmare rooted in ancient folklore and unresolved hatred. As supernatural violence escalates, the group realizes that once Kuntilanak is summoned, the curse will not stop—until it claims everything in its path.

title: Listen, Mom
overview: A grieving playwright returns to his rural hometown to come out to his traditional mother following the sudden death of his partner. Their painful confrontation and the unspoken truths that come to light become the catalyst for him to find his creative voice again.

title: Operasi Pesta Copet
overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

title: Rumah Singgah
overview: Karla, a talented young runner diagnosed with bone cancer, receives treatment at a halfway house. There, she learns to accept reality through the support of the residents and bu Andin, while together they realize their ultimate dream.

title: Rotten
overview: A woman living with the pain of a rotten tooth plans to spend savings on a dentist appointment. But an unexpected afternoon with her boss's wife draws her into a world she cannot afford.

title: Prosecution
overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

title: Muito Prazer
overview: Rubem, a rideshare driver with no prospects, receives as inheritance the Pérola Motel, which he soon discovers is a dilapidated building. There, he meets Grace, a former employee who had stayed on living in one of the suites after the motel closed. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

title: Shark Thrash
overview: A small and touristy beachside town is hit by a storm the size of which nobody could have predicted. A family who just arrived tries to escape, but gets stuck in the quickly rising waters. They try to figure a way out with the help of some locals, but any progress is shut down when the sharks make their way onto the flooded streets. The family and locals must now find a way to survive as the waters rise.

title: Our Secret
overview: A Black Brazilian family in the city of Belo Horizonte, tries to rebuild their home after a recent loss. Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

title: Papi Ricky: La Película
overview: Alicia returns to Chile to introduce her future husband, an eccentric young Spanish hipster who embodies modernity. His arrival causes a family upheaval, and the clash with the conservative Papi Ricky and the irreverent Catrala leads both parents to put aside their old differences and unite around a common goal: stopping their daughter’s wedding.

title: Hive
overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

title: Moonzy: The Dark Side of the Moon
overview: Luntik, Kuzya and Vupsen and Pupsen build a spacecraft to find Luntik's missing dad and encounter adventures in the search.

title: Lone wolf
overview: The docudrama Lone Wolf follows the life and combat experiences of RAF fighter pilot Josef František. Director Ondřej Veverka presents the story of a pilot who made his name whilst serving with the RAF’s 303rd Polish Fighter Squadron during the Battle of Britain. The film portrays Josef František not only as a flying ace with eighteen aerial victories during the Battle of Britain, but also as a man plagued by inner doubts yet possessing exceptional courage.

title: Grin
overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

title: A Delivery from Hell
overview: A package arrives at their doorsteps. There is no sender's name. No explanation as to why it was delivered to them. But the moment they open it, their lives spiral into a nightmare. One by one, lives are put on the line. Now, the question is no longer how to avoid the package, but how to escape the curse once they have received it.

title: Trial of Hein
overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

title: The Chilean
overview: 1976, Aldo, an explosives expert, is exiled to Italy after mining protests. There he meets Luciana, an anarchist doctor who offers to reunite him with his family, but only if he takes up his old trade: making bombs for revolutionaries.

title: God Skin
overview: Win, takes a lethal gamble to fund his mother's medical treatment when Itt, an old friend, lures him into the Arena. In this brutal underground circuit, fighters are marked with "God Skin" tattoos to gain a ruthless edge.

title: Solidarité Incendies - Le Grand Concert en direct
Алмаз «Сердце Персии»
overview: The Cyrus the Great Diamond is stolen from an excavation site in Iran and falls into the hands of a Russian boy vacationing at the seaside with his family.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: The Secret Woman
overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

title: Just Play Dead
overview: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

title: Barreda
overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: Spider Island
overview: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: The Last Scene
overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

title: Once More
overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

title: Babita Singh Reporting
overview: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Hideaway: The Dossiers
overview: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.

title: Gaskins: The Hitchhiker Killer
overview: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution
overview: Tate battles ruthless mercenaries throughout Ibiza as he avenges his friend's death.  Get ready for the biggest and most action packed film in the successful independent crime saga.

title: Corsu Mezu Mezu - Un soir au Vélodrome avec Patrick Fiori
The Sun Never Sets
overview: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

title: Beyond Belief
overview: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

title: The Ghost and The Gun
overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

title: Hi!
overview: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

title: Another
overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

title: The Brightest Sun
overview: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

title: My Playground
overview: Trapped in Dubai where riding is “not allowed,” a young BMX rider hits the road on a worldwide adventure to find  epic spots, a real community — and himself.

title: The Wrong Housemaid
overview: After vanishing from her violent husband's grasp ten years ago, Mona thought she had finally secured a peaceful new life for herself and her teenage daughter, Denise, behind carefully crafted new identities. But their fragile safety shatters when a seemingly harmless housemaid enters their home and begins manipulating their lives with chilling precision.

title: The Back of the Barn
overview: Isolated on his family farm, Peter must reveal the secret that lies in the back of the barn.

title: Much About Love
overview: A TV director returns to her theater roots for a Shakespeare festival and runs into an old flame, rekindling a merry war of wits in this modern retelling of "Much Ado About Nothing."

title: The Copycat Killer
overview: A traumatized criminal profiler is lured in to investigate a copycat killer mimicking her most infamous case while being framed as the prime suspect, or risk losing her freedom and becoming the next victim of a twisted game of revenge.

title: Will Revenge
overview: On what begins as a quiet night at home, four friends are confronted with the news of a devastating act of anti-trans violence. In an instant, their sense of safety is shattered. As shock gives way to grief—and grief to rage—their quiet evening fractures into a shared, unspoken question: what does justice look like when the world refuses to provide it?

title: The Brook
overview: Moving to the village of his mother’s youth, art student Jacob discovers his grandad’s old video camera shows one hour into the past. In Elmbrook, a place steeped in strange folklore and whispered legends, the community believe their village is protected by a puma that watches over the “good.” But when one of the good locals mysteriously vanishes, Jacob and his friends, armed with the video camera, uncover clues that pull them deeper into Elmbrook’s bizarre secrets. Soon the search for answers spirals into a dangerous mystery as they uncover a vengeful serial killer with a connection to the past.

title: El veneno del pueblo
overview: Seventy-six-year-old Elvira lives alone, finding comfort in the glow of her television. When news of a cockroach infestation sparks panic, she turns her home into a fortress of insecticide. But as a strange, viscous substance begins to thrive on the poison, the boundary between the infestation and Elvira’s own decay starts to blur.

title: Meurtres à Fontainebleau
overview: When a murder revives the legend of the "Grand Veneur", the forest of Fontainebleau becomes the hunting ground of an elusive killer.

title: RevPro 14 Year Anniversary Show
overview: Fourteen years of world-class action from Europe’s number one wrestling producers have led to this. On Saturday 29th August 2026, RevPro takes over the iconic OVO ARENA WEMBLEY for its biggest celebration yet—uniting the finest British and international talent for one unforgettable night. Expect championship clashes, dream matches, and the unmatched energy only RevPro fans bring.

title: AEW All In 2026: London
overview: All In 2026, also promoted as All In London, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on August 30, 2026, at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The event featured AEW Men's and Women's World Championship matches earned by the winners of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament.

title: AAA Ola de Calor 2026
overview: Ola de Calor 2026 (Spanish for "Heat Wave") was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right before NXT Heatwave in the same venue.

title: Plonternish
overview: Eli writes a play.

title: Motka
overview: In the improvised café “Radi Motka” in Dorćol, run and informally legalized by the resourceful Srboljub Dudić Srba, a diverse group of locals gathers: Žarko Zrenjanin, Vlada, Bane, Professor, Father Laza, Panja Panić, and Sloba. After a failed eviction, Sloba becomes the target of a media lynching, so the group organizes an improvised trial. This gives birth to SAČ – the Serbian Anti-Thief Squad. Encouraged by their initial success, SAČ members escalate their actions—from kidnapping Živaljević to hunting a dog poisoner—but the line between justice and lawlessness begins to blur. When they discover the poisoner is one of their own, the group falls apart and personal issues come to the surface. Forced to face the consequences of their actions, they manage to find a partial sense of peace, while “Radi Motka” survives as a symbol of their struggle and flawed attempts at justice.

title: Other People
overview: Su is a loner, relying on Anti-Depressants and Benzo, waiting for gas during the gas shortage caused by Iran and American Conflict. Then came her longtime friend Than Dar, and her boyfriend Nay Gyi.

title: NXT Heatwave 2026
overview: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

title: Why Religion?
overview: "Why Religion?" is a feature-length documentary film exploring the extraordinary work and personal journey of renowned scholar Elaine Pagels. Celebrated for her groundbreaking research on the Gnostic Gospels, Pagels challenges conventional religious narratives and invites us to rethink how early western religions approached divinity, enlightenment, and the human experience. The film offers intimate access to her life and work, revealing how her research of ancient texts shaped her own path of spirituality and self-discovery.

title: Cockroaches
overview: Three porch pirates steal a van and find the kidnapped Queen of Belgium in the back. Low-rent larceny spirals into a disaster worth remembering and mutual regret might be mistaken for something deeper. Probably not, but maybe.

title: LOOP
overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

title: Bunny Rabbit
overview: In the aftermath of a climate apocalypse, a young woman roams the ruins of a world she never got to grow up in. Raised on scavenged books and b-movies, she lives alone in an old shack she once shared with her father. Supplies are scarce and food is running out. There’s nothing left to hunt. Nothing except other people...

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.
